The '''Katsu Line''' was a [[commutube]] line in [[Umgul City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Umgul/Legends|Umgul]]. The Katsu Line circled the city, connecting the districts of [[Furgan (Umgul City)|Furgan]] and [[Ganterville]], and providing transport to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. A branch line, the [[Raceway Line]], connected the city to the [[Fondine Blob Raceways]].
